requirements.requirement: The system must execute unit tests that validate distance-to-score mapping produces a normalized value between 0 and 1 for valid distance and duration inputs.
The system must verify via unit tests that shorter distances result in equal or higher proximity scores than longer distances, holding duration constant.
The system must verify via unit tests that shorter travel durations result in equal or higher proximity scores than longer durations, holding distance constant.
The system must execute unit tests confirming that when multiple trial locations are provided, the scoring logic selects the location with the best (highest) proximity score.
The system must execute unit tests confirming that the selected best location metadata (distance, duration, site identifier) matches the location used to compute the final score.
The system must execute unit tests validating fallback behavior when routing distance data is missing, producing a deterministic default proximity score.
The system must execute unit tests validating fallback behavior when routing duration data is missing, producing a deterministic default proximity score.
The system must execute unit tests confirming that when both distance and duration are missing, the proximity score falls back to a defined default without raising an exception.
The system must execute integration tests validating that clinical_trials_service returns proximity scoring outputs conforming to the defined schema.
The system must execute integration tests validating that evaluate_care_facade includes proximity score and metadata in each clinical trial result.
The system must execute integration tests confirming end-to-end flow from clinical_trials_service through evaluate_care_facade returns consistent proximity scores for identical inputs.
The system must execute integration tests confirming that multiple trial results are each independently scored and returned with their own proximity metadata.
The system must execute tests ensuring that invalid input types (e.g., non-numeric distance or duration) are handled gracefully without crashing and result in fallback scoring.
The system must execute tests ensuring that empty trial location lists result in a valid response with a default proximity score and no unhandled exceptions.
The system must achieve passing status for all defined unit and integration tests in the backend/tests suite before feature acceptance.
